samples.summary: The class-level SECURITY contract comment in `preview.ts` still asserts the preview "never renders raw HTML from note content" — a statement the new `imgPlugin` (and, before it, `detailsPlugin`) makes literally false: an `` written as HTML in a note now produces a real `` element in the reader's DOM.
samples.evidence: packages/notes/src/view/preview.ts:187-193 — "SECURITY: `html: false` is deliberate. … so this preview never renders raw HTML from note content." The same file, at line 83, now installs `md.use(imgPlugin)`, and `img-plugin.ts:147` pushes an `image` token for HTML-written `` tags. The contract a future reader (or reviewer of the next plugin) relies on is out of step with the code; the invariant is really "only allowlisted tags with allowlisted attribute sets are recognized". Fix belongs on the new/edited code (`preview.ts`'s comment).

samples.summary: `packages/notes/README.md` enumerates the preview's markdown-it plugins ("`<details>`/`<summary>` collapsibles and list empty-bullet handling") and was not extended with the new sized-image plugin, so the package's own architecture summary now under-describes `view/preview.ts`.
samples.evidence: packages/notes/README.md:14-16 lists the preview plugins; `packages/notes/src/view/preview.ts:83` now also uses `imgPlugin`. (The list already omits KaTeX/mermaid, so it may be intentionally non-exhaustive — hence nit.)

samples.summary: The rendered size of an HTML-written image depends entirely on frontend CSS that this change does not touch: `notes-preview.css` declares no `img` rule at all, so containment of an oversized `width` (e.g. `width="5000"`) and the no-op-ness of `height` come only from Tailwind preflight in `packages/frontend/src/index.css`. Any consumer that mounts `NotePreview` without that stylesheet (harness page, future embed, tests) gets unconstrained images.
samples.evidence: grep for `img` across all `*.css` in the repo returned no match, so `packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-preview.css` has no image rule; the only source of `img { max-width: 100%; height: auto }` is the `@import "tailwindcss"` preflight at packages/frontend/src/index.css:1. `docs/design/notes/notes.md:460-467` acknowledges the preflight dependency and explicitly defers a CSS change, so this is a known, documented gap rather than an oversight — reported for completeness.
